question: What did Maya Chen ask about the renewal of the Premium Operations Plan?
reference: Maya Chen asked whether the premium tier includes onboarding support for two additional factory floors. She also said budget approval depends on knowing the total cost, so a written pricing breakdown was promised.

question: Does a multi-site discount apply at three or more locations?
reference: Yes. Accounts with three or more sites get an automatic 10% discount on the combined multi-site total, and each additional site is billed at 70% of the single-site rate.
